linhas.en: "Back in the day, people used to say,[br]'whatever happens, happens.'"
linhas.Pt-br: "No passado, as pessoas costumavam dizer,[br]'o que tiver que ser, será.'"
linhas.label: $$$message_0288_0000_0000$$$

linhas.en: "At this point, it should be best to obediently surrender to your fate."
linhas.Pt-br: "A este ponto, o melhor a se fazer é se render de forma obediente ao seu destino."
linhas.label: $$$message_0288_0001_0000$$$

linhas.en: "Yeah, if I were to explain my state of mind..."
linhas.Pt-br: "É, se eu fosse tentar explicar o meu estado de espírito..."
linhas.label: $$$message_0288_0002_0000$$$

linhas.en: "You should finish off the year's worth of unfinished business you have, throw your arms up in abandonment while lying on your back as proof of obedience, and then tighten your loincloth and take a great leap of faith in ceremonial funeral clothes!":©ü
